analysis:
This PR widens the Autopilot model set from the persisted operator selection to every verified, cached catalog build that the Mac can run. It also adds Autopilot download settings, ledger usage and free-disk display. The relevant model-integrity threats are A-004, T-012 and T-027; disk availability is covered by T-016.

ScheduledWindowSelection.swift:
- Head lines 69-76 build the cached set only with consent and when privateOnly is off.
- Lines 88-90 rescan each cached ID separately through resolveModels, which re-hashes the weights. A build is accepted only if its fresh weightHash matches a hash verified at startup or by the previous window (isVerifiedCached, line 73).
- Lines 80-86 capture fingerprints before hashing for the cached IDs as well, preserving the stale-bytes protection.
- A failed or missing cached build is dropped and does not fail the window. I saw no path that blesses unverified bytes.

StartCommand+Modes.swift:
- Head lines 220-235 gate AutopilotStartInventory.load on consent and !privateOnly.
- Pending candidates are passed to ProviderLoop, which is said to verify them after registration.
- Line 489 feeds loop.autopilotCachedBuildHashes into the next scheduled window.

StartCommand+Autopilot.swift:
- Head lines 104-107 replace the inline eligibility checks with AutopilotBuildEligibility.allowsCachedBuild. The base checks were active, minRam, ID bounds, EngineV2 support, runtime capability and memory budget.

AutopilotStatusCommand.swift:
- This change is display and JSON output only. It reads the local ledger and the daemon state file; no new trust decision is made from them.

These implementations were not supplied and must be verified in integration:
- AutopilotBuildEligibility.allowsCachedBuild must preserve every base check listed above.
- AutopilotStartInventory.inventory/pending must return only verified catalog builds with non-empty hashes.
- ProviderLoop.autopilotCachedBuildHashes and its post-registration verification must hash bytes against the catalog, not trust ledger or self-reported hashes.
- The Autopilot download path is described as on by default for enrolled Macs (status line 37). It needs checks for disk budget and free-space guards (T-016), catalog-hash verification of downloaded bytes (T-012/T-027), and privateOnly exclusion.

No concrete regression is visible in the supplied source.
